name: Haan Ye Karlo Pehle
visual_description: Comedian Raju Srivastav holding his head in frustration during a stand-up routine, captioned 'Haan ye karlo pehle'.
usage_context: Used sarcastically when someone prioritizes irrelevant tasks or makes absurd demands during critical moments.

example.top_text:
Exam tomorrow morning
Me redesigning my playlist at 3 AM:
